title: Settings group
summary: One screen that renders any settings group of registries/settings.json: its sections in order, each with a title, rows and a footer. Every row says its current value (ADR 0112). Seu perfil, Privacidade, Sua conta, Conversas e mídia and Ajuda e sobre all use it.

key.description: The row key from the registry.

title.description: String key of the row title.

kind.description: From the registry. link opens a screen; choice opens a picker; switch toggles; info shows a value; url opens a page; action runs something; destructive runs something that cannot be undone.

value.description: The current value, formatted: the subtitle of a link or choice row, the text of an info row.

footer.description: String key of the one-line footer that says what the row changes.

key.description: The section key from the registry.

title.description: String key of the section title.

of.description: A row that passed its gate.

footer.description: String key of the section footer.

group.description: The group key: profile, privacy, account, chats or help.

of.description: A section with one row or more.

sections.description: Sections in registry order. A section whose rows are all hidden is left out.

waysBackWarning.description: account only: bipe_fallback_reminder (none) or bipe_account_paths_warning (one) on the status card.

version.description: help only: the app version name and build from product/version.json, for bipe_help_version.

appear.effect: Builds sections from the generated BipeSettings group, drops rows whose gate hides them, then reads the value of each row (see notes).

tapRow.effect: link and choice: open the screen of the row (see notes). url: opens the page of the row's url key from registries/settings.json urls, in pt or en by the app language, in the in-app browser. action and destructive: run the row (see notes).

toggle.effect: Saves the switch at once and shows the new value. A failed save puts the switch back and shows bipe_error_generic. appLock follows app-lock.

longPressVersion.effect: help only: copies the Matrix device ID (Client.deviceId) and shows bipe_help_device_id_copied. The device ID never shows as text (ADR 0112).

notes: Row titles and footers are the string keys in registries/settings.json; the spec does not repeat them. The registry is the one source of order, keys, gates and strings on both platforms (ADR 0031, ADR 0112).

Gates: absent → shown; ios or android → that platform only; flag:<name> → shown when that build flag is on; planned:<issue> and any unknown gate → hidden (fail closed). Bipe logic: BipeSettingsRow.isShownOnIOS (BipeKit BipeSettingsSupport.swift) and BipeSettingsGate.isShown (libraries/bipe settings).
Row targets, profile: namePhoto → the profile editor, handle → the @ screen, publicProfile → the public profile screen (bipe-chat/bipe#567).

Row targets, privacy: messaging → the who-can-message picker (PUT /v1/me/messaging), requestPhotos → a local switch, blocked → the blocked list (bipe-chat/bipe#567), number → info from GET /v1/me/phone with the yearly confirmation state (phone-link-status), discovery → PUT /v1/me/discovery, contacts → the contacts screen, presence → a switch for typing and online state, readReceipts → info with no switch (always on, ADR 0050), whoCanRead and whatBipeKeeps → url, export → data-export.

Row targets, account: waysBackStatus → the status card (count and warning), changePin → pin-change, appLock → app-lock (turn on or off), biometricUnlock → a switch that exists only while the lock is on, email → the recovery email screen, linkedAccounts → linked-accounts, recoveryKey → recovery-key-save, thisDevice → info with this phone's model, linkedDevices → linked-devices, add → the second-account flow (ADR 0086), signOut → sign-out, delete → account-delete (ADR 0140). While a deletion waits and this phone asked, the account-delete banner sits at the top of the group and the delete row is hidden.

bipe_account_pin_footer takes pinLength. With two accounts on the phone (ADR 0086), show bipe_account_pin_footer_device. bipe_account_biometric_unlock takes Face ID or Touch ID on iOS and bipe_account_biometric_word_android on Android.

Row targets, chats: appearance → a picker (system, light, dark: bipe_chats_appearance_system, _light, _dark), kept on the phone, language → iOS only, opens the iPhone's Ajustes page of the app, mediaQuality → the photo and video quality screen, showMedia → a picker, dataUse → the data-use screen (bipe#242), liveLocation → a picker of the update distance of live location: registries/maps.json live.distancesMetres, each as bipe_chats_live_location_distance with the distance in metres ('50 m'), default live.defaultDistanceMetres, kept on the phone (spec location-send notes, updates).

Row targets, help: support → support-open, docs, terms and privacy → url, reportProblem → problem-report, licenses → open-source-licences. The section footer is bipe_about_steward (ADR 0040), then bipe_help_version with version.

Help links (parity help-links): every 'learn more' link in the app goes to a bipe.chat page from registries/settings.json urls or registries/legal.json, never to element.io or matrix.org. Bipe logic: AttributedString+BipeLink.swift and BipeLegalLinks.swift (BipeKit); BipeLinks.kt (libraries/bipe).

Haptics (parity haptics): the settings screens play only the uses in registries/haptics.json: tap for copy (the device ID), success for pin_set and app_unlock, error for pin_wrong, through the generated BipeHaptics. A new use needs a line in the registry first. The app never calls a platform feedback API directly, and has no haptics row: the system setting wins (design/haptics.md rule 6, ADR 0134).
Notifications has screen element in the registry; in Bipe's own client it is the notifications settings spec of bipe-chat/bipe#565, not this screen.
A company account with an owner on this phone (account-switcher notes, bipe-chat/bipe#444) shows bipe_account_company_owner with the owner's name at the top of the account group. Only on this phone.
